title: SvgLine
responsibility: Renders the native line element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgLine.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet, rendered inside the native SVG <line> element when it is truthy. The component calls it with no arguments and does not otherwise validate or transform its output.

outputs.name: SvgLine
outputs.description: The rendered output is a native SVG <line> element. It receives every prop except children as a spread attribute, and renders children inside the element when truthy.
